name: Rohan
label: Version-rolling Android user avoids updates
who: I am an Android Spotify user who rolled back to an older app version and turned off auto-updates to avoid the new layout [20][27]. I mainly use Spotify to listen to music, and I would rather keep an older app that still works.
value_for_money: Price is not the focus. One post jokes that older app versions mean you don't have to pay for Premium [39]. Others say they would cancel if the new layout is forced [16][18].
loyalty: Stays on an older Spotify build that still works, and says they will cancel the day the new layout is forced [16]. One poster already cancelled after an auto-update [18].
pain_points: Auto-updates push the new layout without notice [18]
Cannot tell which changes are A/B tests [22]
The old layout returns, then reverts [24][34]
likes: Older app version that still works [20]
Layout reverting to the familiar one [24]
reasons_to_stay: They keep Spotify because they just want to listen to music [31] and because an older build still works for them [20][27]. Their complaints are about forced changes rather than the core listening experience.
tone: Matter-of-fact and practical, sharing workarounds in short, lowercase-leaning sentences.
